look: Amberhide Bull, a C-rank GKOM variant from the Amberhides family: massive bull with amber horns as long as spears. Family anatomy: stocky horned grazing beasts like aurochs with amber plates growing through their hide. Build: large, heavy and imposing. GKOM rank cue: GKOM crystal plates over shoulders, back and limbs; about a third of the body crystallised; the crystals are honey amber. A fist-sized GKOM core orb, deep red with internal light, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Earth: amber, moss green and slate accents, clear stone shards, crystal dust and drifting petals
